body_preview: metadata: id: agentic-action-classification name: Agentic Action Classification description: Classify every agent tool and action as High, Medium, or Low impact; maintain a documented matrix; use classification to drive approval requirements, audit depth, and capability grants. version: "1.0.0" tags
description: Classify every agent tool and action as High, Medium, or Low impact; maintain a documented matrix; use classification to drive approval requirements, audit depth, and capability grants.
name: Agentic Action Classification
summary: Classify every agent tool as High (financial, infra, secrets, prod-writes), Medium (PRs, internal comms, non-prod), or Low (read-only, public data); document the matrix; use classification to gate approval and audit. (NIST AI RMF MAP-2.1)

body_preview: metadata: id: agentic-bulk-limits name: Agentic Bulk Limits description: Enforce per-request tool-call caps for agents; require user re-engagement before continuing bulk operations; target systems must enforce their own rate and volume limits. version: "1.0.0" tags: [agentic, rate-limiting, bulk-act
description: Enforce per-request tool-call caps for agents; require user re-engagement before continuing bulk operations; target systems must enforce their own rate and volume limits.
name: Agentic Bulk Limits
summary: Cap agent tool calls per user request (default ≤20); require user re-engagement before additional bulk operations; target APIs must enforce independent volume limits; never silently loop. (OWASP LLM06)

body_preview: metadata: id: agentic-human-approval name: Agentic Human Approval description: Agents must not autonomously execute High-Impact actions; the agent prepares, the human executes. Asking permission is insufficient—the agent must lack the capability. version: "1.0.0" tags: [agentic, human-in-the-loop, a
description: Agents must not autonomously execute High-Impact actions; the agent prepares, the human executes. Asking permission is insufficient—the agent must lack the capability.
name: Agentic Human Approval
summary: Deny agents execution capability for High-Impact actions (financial, infra, secrets, prod writes); agent prepares and drafts, human executes; permission-asking alone is insufficient—capability removal is the control. (ISO 42001 A.9.1)

body_preview: metadata: id: agentic-obo-auth name: Agentic On-Behalf-Of Authentication description: Agents must access remote systems using the current user's token or OAuth2 OBO flow; never use a shared service principal; every agent action must be attributable to the real user. version: "1.0.0" tags: [agentic,
description: Agents must access remote systems using the current user's token or OAuth2 OBO flow; never use a shared service principal; every agent action must be attributable to the real user.
name: Agentic On-Behalf-Of Authentication
summary: Agents must use the current user's delegated token (OAuth2 OBO or passthrough) for every downstream API call; never use a shared service principal; RBAC must be enforced at the target; every agent action must be attributable to the real user. (RFC 8693)

body_preview: metadata: id: agentic-tool-scoping name: Agentic Tool Scoping description: Provision each agent with only the minimum tools required for its specific task; document and review the tool inventory; avoid broad or catch-all MCP server access. version: "1.0.0" tags: [agentic, mcp, tool-calling, least-pr
description: Provision each agent with only the minimum tools required for its specific task; document and review the tool inventory; avoid broad or catch-all MCP server access.
name: Agentic Tool Scoping
summary: Grant each agent only the tools it actually needs (≤5 for narrow tasks); document each tool with a justification; reject catch-all or admin-scoped MCP servers; review tool inventories at least quarterly. (ISO 42001 A.9.1)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-audit-logging name: AI Audit Logging description: Log all LLM requests, responses, and tool calls with user identity, model version, token counts, and decision outcome; enforce retention TTL; integrate with SIEM for anomaly detection. version: "1.0.0" tags: [ai-security, audit, logg
description: Log all LLM requests, responses, and tool calls with user identity, model version, token counts, and decision outcome; enforce retention TTL; integrate with SIEM for anomaly detection.
name: AI Audit Logging
summary: Log every LLM request, response, and tool call with: user identity, model version, token counts, decision, inputs-hash; enforce data-retention TTL; feed SIEM for anomaly detection; support per-user throttling. (ISO 27001 A.8.15)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-bias-fairness name: AI Bias and Fairness description: Test for disparate impact across protected groups before deployment; define quantitative fairness metrics; audit training data for representation and labeling bias; monitor for drift in production. version: "1.0.0" tags: [ai-gove
description: Test for disparate impact across protected groups before deployment; define quantitative fairness metrics; audit training data for representation and labeling bias; monitor for drift in production.
name: AI Bias and Fairness
summary: Perform pre-deployment bias audit across protected groups; define and measure at least one quantitative fairness metric (demographic parity, equalized odds); audit training data for representation; monitor production for bias drift; document remediation procedures. (EU AI Act Art. 10)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-code-provenance name: AI Code Provenance description: Every AI-generated or AI-assisted commit must carry a Co-Authored-By trailer identifying the AI tool; CI verifies the trailer is present on flagged commits; enables attribution, audit, and downstream license analysis. version: "1
description: Every AI-generated or AI-assisted commit must carry a Co-Authored-By trailer identifying the AI tool; CI verifies the trailer is present on flagged commits; enables attribution, audit, and downstream license analysis.
name: AI Code Provenance
summary: Add Co-Authored-By trailer to every AI-generated commit (e.g., Co-Authored-By: github-copilot[bot]); CI verifies trailer on AI-flagged commits; enables audit, license analysis, and supply-chain traceability. (ISO 42001 A.8.4)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-content-moderation name: AI Content Moderation description: Filter AI output for harmful, toxic, or brand-damaging content before publication; require human review for AI content reaching external audiences; apply stricter configs for public-facing AI. version: "1.0.0" tags: [ai-sec
description: Filter AI output for harmful, toxic, or brand-damaging content before publication; require human review for AI content reaching external audiences; apply stricter configs for public-facing AI.
name: AI Content Moderation
summary: Filter all AI-generated output through a content moderation pipeline before reaching external audiences; require human review for public-facing content; use stricter configs for public vs internal; log all moderation decisions. (OWASP LLM02)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-data-classification name: AI Data Classification description: Classify every data source used by AI systems (training, RAG, inference context) for sensitivity; maintain a data-source inventory with owner and classification; identify uncontrolled sources explicitly. version: "1.0.0"
description: Classify every data source used by AI systems (training, RAG, inference context) for sensitivity; maintain a data-source inventory with owner and classification; identify uncontrolled sources explicitly.
name: AI Data Classification
summary: Classify every AI data source (training, RAG, context) for sensitivity (PII, confidential, regulated, public); maintain an owner-attributed inventory; tag uncontrolled sources (web scrape, public APIs) explicitly; drive access control from classification. (ISO 42001 A.7.3)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-data-provenance name: AI Data Provenance description: Document lineage for all AI training and inference data; enforce quality gates before model training; version datasets; detect train/test contamination; maintain queryable, immutable lineage records. version: "1.0.0" tags: [ai-go
description: Document lineage for all AI training and inference data; enforce quality gates before model training; version datasets; detect train/test contamination; maintain queryable, immutable lineage records.
name: AI Data Provenance
summary: Document source, transformation, and quality for all AI training and inference data; enforce automated quality gates (completeness, accuracy, consistency) before training; version datasets; detect train-test contamination; keep lineage immutable and queryable. (ISO 42001 A.7.1)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-data-segregation name: AI Data Segregation description: User-supplied data must only serve that user; enforce per-user namespacing in vector stores; no cross-user data leakage; TTL on all user-supplied content; no long-term cross-session memory without Privacy approval. version: "1.
description: User-supplied data must only serve that user; enforce per-user namespacing in vector stores; no cross-user data leakage; TTL on all user-supplied content; no long-term cross-session memory without Privacy approval.
name: AI Data Segregation
summary: Isolate all user-supplied AI context (chat history, uploads, embeddings) to the originating user; never allow cross-user data leakage; enforce TTL on user-supplied content; segment vector stores by sensitivity; prohibit cross-session memory without Privacy/Legal approval. (GDPR Art. 5)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-explainability name: AI Explainability description: Document model choices, data lineage, and intended use; disclose AI interaction to users; provide layered explanations (outcome, process, counterfactual); treat explainability as a design requirement. version: "1.0.0" tags: [ai-gov
description: Document model choices, data lineage, and intended use; disclose AI interaction to users; provide layered explanations (outcome, process, counterfactual); treat explainability as a design requirement.
name: AI Explainability
summary: Author a model card for every deployed AI system documenting purpose, limitations, and data lineage; notify users they are interacting with AI; provide outcome-level explanations; define prohibited uses; track model versions and retraining events. (EU AI Act Art. 13)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-guardrails name: AI Guardrails description: Implement input and output guardrails on all LLM interactions; use platform guardrail configs; apply stricter controls for public-facing AI; version guardrail configurations alongside model deployments. version: "1.0.0" tags: [ai-security,
description: Implement input and output guardrails on all LLM interactions; use platform guardrail configs; apply stricter controls for public-facing AI; version guardrail configurations alongside model deployments.
name: AI Guardrails
summary: Apply input guardrails (PII detection, injection blocking, content policy) and output guardrails (harmful-content filter, PII redaction, topic validation) to every LLM interaction; use stricter configs for public-facing AI; version guardrail configs. (OWASP LLM01+LLM02)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-human-oversight name: AI Human Oversight description: Every AI system must have a tested kill switch, confidence-threshold escalation to human reviewers, logged human overrides, graceful degradation to manual processes, and documented escalation procedures. version: "1.0.0" tags: [a
description: Every AI system must have a tested kill switch, confidence-threshold escalation to human reviewers, logged human overrides, graceful degradation to manual processes, and documented escalation procedures.
name: AI Human Oversight
summary: Equip every production AI system with a tested kill switch, confidence-threshold-based escalation to human reviewers, immutable override logs (who/when/why/what), graceful degradation to manual fallback, and documented escalation tiers. (ISO 42001 A.9.2)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-kill-switch name: AI Kill Switch description: Every agentic system must have a documented, tested kill switch covering session termination, model rollback, and traffic gating; activation must be immediate, authorized, and produce an immutable audit entry. version: "1.0.0" tags: [ai-
description: Every agentic system must have a documented, tested kill switch covering session termination, model rollback, and traffic gating; activation must be immediate, authorized, and produce an immutable audit entry.
name: AI Kill Switch
summary: Every agentic AI system must document and regularly test a kill switch at three layers (session terminate, model rollback, traffic gate); activation must halt processing within seconds, require authorized credentials, and produce an immutable audit entry. (ISO 42001 A.8.2)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-model-lifecycle name: AI Model Lifecycle description: Govern the full AI model lifecycle from design through decommissioning; require model versioning and registry; define lifecycle stages with quality gates; detect drift; support canary deployment and rollback. version: "1.0.0" tag
description: Govern the full AI model lifecycle from design through decommissioning; require model versioning and registry; define lifecycle stages with quality gates; detect drift; support canary deployment and rollback.
name: AI Model Lifecycle
summary: Register all AI models in a centralized registry with versioned artifacts; enforce lifecycle stages (design → test → approval → production → decommission) with documented quality gates; detect data/concept/performance drift; deploy via canary with automatic rollback. (ISO 42001 A.6.2)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-rate-limiting name: AI Rate Limiting description: Enforce per-user and per-team request and token-budget limits on AI API access; monitor consumption; scope prompts to relevant context only; avoid mixing unrelated tasks in one session. version: "1.0.0" tags: [ai-security, rate-limit
description: Enforce per-user and per-team request and token-budget limits on AI API access; monitor consumption; scope prompts to relevant context only; avoid mixing unrelated tasks in one session.
name: AI Rate Limiting
summary: Enforce per-user and per-team AI request and token-budget limits; monitor consumption and alert on anomalies; scope prompts to relevant context only (never whole-repo); use one session per task to keep context clean and costs predictable. (NIST AI RMF GOVERN-1.1)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-regulatory-compliance name: AI Regulatory Compliance description: Engage Legal before deploying AI subject to regulation; classify AI systems under EU AI Act; complete data classification; require Secure-by-Design review; assess third-party AI vendors; screen for prohibited use case
description: Engage Legal before deploying AI subject to regulation; classify AI systems under EU AI Act; complete data classification; require Secure-by-Design review; assess third-party AI vendors; screen for prohibited use cases.
name: AI Regulatory Compliance
summary: Engage Legal before deploying regulated AI; classify under EU AI Act tiers; complete data classification; require Secure-by-Design review; assess third-party AI; prohibit unauthorized surveillance, discrimination, and deepfakes. (EU AI Act Art. 5)

body_preview: metadata: id: ai-third-party-ai name: AI Third-Party AI Governance description: Apply AI-specific vendor assessment beyond standard procurement; require AI-specific contractual clauses; monitor for drift and silent model updates; define subprocessor requirements and exit strategy. version: "1.0.0" t
description: Apply AI-specific vendor assessment beyond standard procurement; require AI-specific contractual clauses; monitor for drift and silent model updates; define subprocessor requirements and exit strategy.
name: AI Third-Party AI Governance
summary: Assess third-party AI vendors with AI-specific criteria (data handling, model updates, bias SLAs, audit rights); require AI-specific contract clauses; monitor for silent model changes; document subprocessors; define exit strategy. (ISO 42001 A.10.1)

body_preview: metadata: id: llm-output-sanitization name: LLM Output Sanitization description: Strip prompt-injection markers and embedded tool-invocation syntax from LLM outputs; escape outputs context-appropriately before rendering; reject outputs that contain structural command sequences. version: "1.0.0" tags
description: Strip prompt-injection markers and embedded tool-invocation syntax from LLM outputs; escape outputs context-appropriately before rendering; reject outputs that contain structural command sequences.
name: LLM Output Sanitization
summary: Sanitize every LLM output before rendering or passing downstream: strip injection markers, escape for context (HTML/SQL/shell), reject outputs containing embedded tool-invocation syntax or instruction-override sequences; never trust model output as safe. (OWASP LLM02)

body_preview: metadata: id: mcp-server-safety name: MCP Server Safety description: MCP servers must follow an approved blueprint, be registered, implement authentication (OBO where applicable), pass Secure-by-Design review, and be protected by WAF/rate-limiting if internet-facing. version: "1.0.0" tags: [ai-secur
description: MCP servers must follow an approved blueprint, be registered, implement authentication (OBO where applicable), pass Secure-by-Design review, and be protected by WAF/rate-limiting if internet-facing.
name: MCP Server Safety
summary: Build MCP servers from approved blueprints; register in approved catalog before deployment; implement OBO auth for user-scoped actions; complete Secure-by-Design review; add WAF + rate-limiting for internet-facing endpoints. (MCP spec)

body_preview: metadata: id: prompt-injection-prevention name: Prompt Injection Prevention description: Validate and sanitize all LLM inputs; detect injection patterns; separate system prompts from user content; use constrained interfaces for high-risk flows. version: "1.0.0" tags: [ai-security, prompt-injection,
description: Validate and sanitize all LLM inputs; detect injection patterns; separate system prompts from user content; use constrained interfaces for high-risk flows.
name: Prompt Injection Prevention
summary: Sanitize all LLM inputs before model invocation; detect injection patterns (role-override, instruction-leakage, delimiter confusion); never concatenate user content into the system prompt; use constrained interfaces where possible. (OWASP LLM01)

body_preview: metadata: id: access-control name: Access Control description: Enforce server-side authorization on every request; deny by default; prevent IDOR; apply least privilege. version: "1.0.0" tags: [access-control, authorization, rbac, abac, least-privilege, idor] category: coding-standards severity: crit
description: Enforce server-side authorization on every request; deny by default; prevent IDOR; apply least privilege.
name: Access Control
summary: Enforce server-side authorization on every request. Deny by default. Verify resource ownership to prevent IDOR. Centralize checks in middleware; never rely on client-side role checks alone.

body_preview: metadata: id: auth-patterns name: Secure Authentication Patterns description: Use Argon2id/bcrypt for passwords, validate JWTs fully, manage sessions securely; ban MD5/SHA-1 for password storage. version: "1.0.0" tags: [authentication, passwords, jwt, sessions, bcrypt, argon2] category: coding-stand
description: Use Argon2id/bcrypt for passwords, validate JWTs fully, manage sessions securely; ban MD5/SHA-1 for password storage.
name: Secure Authentication Patterns
summary: Hash passwords with Argon2id or bcrypt (cost ≥12). Validate JWTs with signature, expiry, and issuer checks. Set session cookies httpOnly, secure, SameSite=strict. Ban MD5/SHA-1 for credentials.

body_preview: metadata: id: cors-security name: CORS Security description: Configure CORS with explicit, minimal origin allowlists; never use wildcard (*) with credentials; reflect Origin header only after validation. version: "1.0.0" tags: [cors, cross-origin, http-headers, api-security] category: coding-standar
description: Configure CORS with explicit, minimal origin allowlists; never use wildcard (*) with credentials; reflect Origin header only after validation.
name: CORS Security
summary: Configure CORS with an explicit origin allowlist. Never use wildcard (*) when credentials are included. Validate the Origin header server-side; do not reflect arbitrary origins. Restrict allowed methods and headers.

body_preview: metadata: id: cryptography-standards name: Cryptography Standards description: Use only approved algorithms (AES-256-GCM, Argon2id, SHA-256+, Ed25519); ban MD5, SHA-1, DES, 3DES, RC4, ECB mode; use OS CSPRNG for all random material. version: "1.0.0" tags: [cryptography, encryption, hashing, key-mana
description: Use only approved algorithms (AES-256-GCM, Argon2id, SHA-256+, Ed25519); ban MD5, SHA-1, DES, 3DES, RC4, ECB mode; use OS CSPRNG for all random material.
name: Cryptography Standards
summary: Use AES-256-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 for encryption; Argon2id or bcrypt(≥12) for passwords; SHA-256+ for hashing. Ban MD5, SHA-1, DES, 3DES, RC4, ECB. Use OS CSPRNG; never Math.random() for secrets.

body_preview: metadata: id: dependency-management name: Dependency Management description: Pin dependencies with exact versions and integrity hashes; scan for known CVEs in CI; keep an SBOM; remove unused dependencies promptly. version: "1.0.0" tags: [dependencies, sca, sbom, supply-chain, cve, lockfile] category
description: Pin dependencies with exact versions and integrity hashes; scan for known CVEs in CI; keep an SBOM; remove unused dependencies promptly.
name: Dependency Management
summary: Pin all dependencies with exact versions and integrity hashes. Scan for CVEs in CI. Maintain a CycloneDX SBOM. Remove unused packages. Never install packages from untrusted sources.

body_preview: metadata: id: error-handling name: Secure Error Handling description: Return generic error messages to clients; log full details server-side; never expose stack traces, internal paths, or sensitive data in responses. version: "1.0.0" tags: [error-handling, information-disclosure, logging, exception-
description: Return generic error messages to clients; log full details server-side; never expose stack traces, internal paths, or sensitive data in responses.
name: Secure Error Handling
summary: Return generic error messages to clients. Log full error details server-side only. Never expose stack traces, internal paths, SQL errors, or sensitive data in API responses. Catch all unhandled rejections.

body_preview: metadata: id: input-validation name: Input Validation description: Validate all user input server-side for type, length, format, and range; use allowlists; reject invalid input before processing. version: "1.0.0" tags: [input-validation, sanitization, allowlist, injection, xss] category: coding-stan
description: Validate all user input server-side for type, length, format, and range; use allowlists; reject invalid input before processing.
name: Input Validation
summary: Validate all user input server-side: type, length, format, and range. Use allowlists over blocklists. Reject invalid input before processing. Never trust client-side validation alone.

body_preview: metadata: id: no-hardcoded-secrets name: No Hardcoded Secrets description: Prohibit API keys, passwords, tokens, private keys, and connection strings in source code; require environment variables or secret managers. version: "1.0.0" tags: [secrets, credentials, api-keys, tokens, secret-management, t
description: Prohibit API keys, passwords, tokens, private keys, and connection strings in source code; require environment variables or secret managers.
name: No Hardcoded Secrets
summary: Never hardcode API keys, passwords, tokens, private keys, or connection strings in source code. Load secrets from environment variables or a secret manager (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault). Commit .env.example only.

body_preview: metadata: id: no-sql-injection name: No SQL Injection description: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements for all database interactions; never concatenate user input into SQL strings. version: "1.0.0" tags: [sql-injection, parameterized-queries, orm, prepared-statements, database] category
description: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements for all database interactions; never concatenate user input into SQL strings.
name: No SQL Injection
summary: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements for all SQL. Never concatenate or interpolate user input into query strings. Use an ORM or query builder; validate identifiers against an allowlist if dynamic column names are required.

body_preview: metadata: id: output-encoding name: Output Encoding description: Context-sensitively encode all output rendered in HTML, JavaScript, CSS, URLs, or XML; use trusted sanitizer libraries; never use innerHTML with user data. version: "1.0.0" tags: [output-encoding, xss, html-encoding, content-security-p
description: Context-sensitively encode all output rendered in HTML, JavaScript, CSS, URLs, or XML; use trusted sanitizer libraries; never use innerHTML with user data.
name: Output Encoding
summary: Encode all user-controlled output before rendering: HTML-encode for HTML context, JS-encode for script context, URL-encode for URLs. Use DOMPurify for HTML sanitization. Set Content-Security-Policy headers. Never use innerHTML with unsanitized input.

body_preview: metadata: id: secure-configuration name: Secure Configuration description: Disable debug features in production, enforce HTTPS, set security headers, use allowlisted configurations, and separate config from code. version: "1.0.0" tags: [secure-configuration, hardening, security-headers, https, debug
description: Disable debug features in production, enforce HTTPS, set security headers, use allowlisted configurations, and separate config from code.
name: Secure Configuration
summary: Disable debug mode, verbose errors, and admin interfaces in production. Enforce HTTPS with HSTS. Set security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options). Separate configuration from code. Remove default credentials and unused features.

body_preview: metadata: id: secure-deserialization name: Secure Deserialization description: Never deserialize untrusted data with unsafe deserializers; validate types after deserialization; avoid Java native, Python pickle, and PHP unserialize with user data. version: "1.0.0" tags: [deserialization, pickle, java
description: Never deserialize untrusted data with unsafe deserializers; validate types after deserialization; avoid Java native, Python pickle, and PHP unserialize with user data.
name: Secure Deserialization
summary: Never deserialize untrusted data with gadget-chain-prone formats (Java native serialization, Python pickle, PHP unserialize). Use JSON or Protobuf; validate structure and types after parsing. Integrity-check serialized blobs before deserializing.

body_preview: metadata: id: security-logging name: Security Logging description: Log authentication, authorization, and security events with sufficient context for forensic analysis; protect logs from tampering; never log credentials or PII. version: "1.0.0" tags: [logging, audit-trail, forensics, siem, security-
description: Log authentication, authorization, and security events with sufficient context for forensic analysis; protect logs from tampering; never log credentials or PII.
name: Security Logging
summary: Log all authentication, authorization, and security events with timestamp, user ID, IP, and action. Never log passwords, tokens, or PII. Protect log integrity. Centralize logs and set retention policy aligned to incident-response timelines.

body_preview: metadata: id: session-management name: Session Management description: Generate cryptographically random session IDs; regenerate on login and privilege changes; expire idle and absolute sessions; invalidate on logout; use secure cookie attributes. version: "1.0.0" tags: [session-management, csrf, se
description: Generate cryptographically random session IDs; regenerate on login and privilege changes; expire idle and absolute sessions; invalidate on logout; use secure cookie attributes.
name: Session Management
summary: Use CSPRNG-generated session IDs (≥128 bits). Regenerate IDs after login and privilege change. Set absolute and idle session timeouts. Invalidate server-side on logout. Set cookies httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=strict. Implement CSRF protection.

body_preview: metadata: id: cryptography-standards-java name: Cryptography Standards — Java description: Java-specific cryptography guidance using JCA/JCE, Bouncy Castle, Spring Security Crypto; ban MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5/SHA1") for security, SecureRandom misuse, and ECB mode. version: "1.0.0" tags: [cryp
description: Java-specific cryptography guidance using JCA/JCE, Bouncy Castle, Spring Security Crypto; ban MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5/SHA1") for security, SecureRandom misuse, and ECB mode.
name: Cryptography Standards — Java
summary: Use SecureRandom for all random material; AES/GCM/NoPadding for encryption; BCryptPasswordEncoder or Argon2PasswordEncoder (Spring Security) for passwords. Ban MessageDigest.getInstance('MD5' or 'SHA-1') in security contexts and Cipher.getInstance('AES/ECB/...').

body_preview: metadata: id: cryptography-standards-python name: Cryptography Standards — Python description: Python-specific cryptography guidance using the cryptography library (pyca), secrets module, and argon2-cffi; ban PyCrypto, pycryptodome unsafe patterns, and random module for security use. version: "1.0.0
description: Python-specific cryptography guidance using the cryptography library (pyca), secrets module, and argon2-cffi; ban PyCrypto, pycryptodome unsafe patterns, and random module for security use.
name: Cryptography Standards — Python
summary: Use pyca/cryptography for symmetric and asymmetric ops; argon2-cffi for password hashing; secrets module for tokens. Ban random, hashlib.md5/sha1 for security, and PyCrypto (unmaintained). Never store keys in source or config files.

body_preview: metadata: id: input-validation-go name: Input Validation — Go description: Go-specific input validation using go-playground/validator v10; decode into typed structs; reject unknown fields; validate path and query parameters explicitly. version: "1.0.0" tags: [input-validation, go, golang, validator,
description: Go-specific input validation using go-playground/validator v10; decode into typed structs; reject unknown fields; validate path and query parameters explicitly.
name: Input Validation — Go
summary: Decode JSON into typed Go structs with json.NewDecoder; disallow unknown fields with Decoder.DisallowUnknownFields(). Validate with github.com/go-playground/validator/v10. Never use map[string]interface{} as the primary input type at security boundaries.

body_preview: metadata: id: input-validation-java name: Input Validation — Java description: Java-specific input validation using Jakarta Bean Validation (@Valid, @NotBlank, @Size); validate DTOs at controller boundary; sanitize HTML with OWASP Java HTML Sanitizer. version: "1.0.0" tags: [input-validation, java,
description: Java-specific input validation using Jakarta Bean Validation (@Valid, @NotBlank, @Size); validate DTOs at controller boundary; sanitize HTML with OWASP Java HTML Sanitizer.
name: Input Validation — Java
summary: Use Jakarta Bean Validation (@Valid, @NotBlank, @Size, @Pattern) on all Spring @RequestBody and @RequestParam inputs. Apply @Validated at the service layer for nested calls. Sanitize HTML with OWASP Java HTML Sanitizer. Reject unknown fields with @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=false).

body_preview: metadata: id: input-validation-javascript name: Input Validation — JavaScript description: JavaScript-specific input validation using Joi, Zod, or express-validator; validate before use; enforce type coercion awareness. version: "1.0.0" tags: [input-validation, javascript, joi, express-validator, no
description: JavaScript-specific input validation using Joi, Zod, or express-validator; validate before use; enforce type coercion awareness.
name: Input Validation — JavaScript
summary: Use Joi, Zod, or express-validator for all JavaScript API boundary inputs. Be explicit about type coercion (== vs ===); never rely on falsy checks alone for security decisions. Validate query params, path params, and headers as well as body.

body_preview: metadata: id: input-validation-python name: Input Validation — Python description: Python-specific input validation using pydantic or marshmallow; use type annotations; avoid eval/exec on user input; validate file uploads with python-magic. version: "1.0.0" tags: [input-validation, python, pydantic,
description: Python-specific input validation using pydantic or marshmallow; use type annotations; avoid eval/exec on user input; validate file uploads with python-magic.
name: Input Validation — Python
summary: Use pydantic (v2) or marshmallow for schema validation at all Python API boundaries. Never pass user input to eval(), exec(), or subprocess without strict allowlisting. Validate file type with python-magic, not just the extension.

body_preview: metadata: id: input-validation-typescript name: Input Validation — TypeScript description: TypeScript-specific input validation using Zod, class-validator, or equivalent; enforce strict types; no any on boundary inputs. version: "1.0.0" tags: [input-validation, typescript, zod, class-validator, expr
description: TypeScript-specific input validation using Zod, class-validator, or equivalent; enforce strict types; no any on boundary inputs.
name: Input Validation — TypeScript
summary: Use Zod or class-validator for runtime schema validation at all TypeScript API boundaries. Enable strict mode; prohibit 'any' on incoming request bodies. Validate before type-asserting. Return structured 400 errors.
